messages:
srebot: PAGE -> PROD: high p95 latency observed for inference-prod (us-west1). Alert: p95 > 3s, error rate up. Pager: @michelle. Impact: user-facing API timeouts starting ~11:34 UTC.
michelle: I'm on it. starting live triage, will gather traces + perf. tagging @aditya @kevin for infra/rt.
aditya: grabbing traces now. early view: spike aligns with recent node patch rollout at 11:30. sending zips to /tmp/tracepack.tar.gz and linking here: https://artifacts.internal/tracepack/3057778888
kevin: running quick perf counters on node-a1. results: `task-clock: 1200.0msec
cycles: 1.2B
context-switches: 86k
page-faults: 14k` — weird tail on syscall latency, lots of futex wait.
nina: checked dmesg on node-a1: "[11:31:02] kernel: sched: preempt_softness changed; user requested update" — we had kernel 5.15.12 -> 5.15.13 pushed in canary at 11:28.
michelle: customer impact: several customers report 5-20% request failures & p95 from ~850ms -> 3200ms. raising SEV. mitigation suggestions?
thomas: immediate mitigations: 1) route heavy requests to fallback model (cpu backed) 2) enable per-route caching for common prefixes 3) scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPUs. Can we flip routing quickly?
aditya: I can enable fallback routing for inference-prod: run: ``/bin/rwctl route create --from inference-prod --to inference-fallback --policy=p95_cutover --threshold=2000`` — applying now.
ops_bot: ACTION: routing change executed by aditya at 11:42 UTC. 12% traffic shifted to fallback.
kevin: continuing investigation: perf top sample attached:
```
# samples: 200
   35.0%  runq_slack  [kernel scheduling]  __schedule
   22.0%  futex_wait  [user land]            futex_wait_queue_me
   10.0%  get_user_pages_fast  [kernel mm]
```
michelle: logs requested. aditya, can you drop full perf.data and trace spans to a shared bucket? include `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 60` output.
aditya: uploaded perf.data -> s3://redwood-debug/3057778888/perf.data.gz and trace spans to traces/3057778888.json.gz. shared link: https://s3.redwood/traces/3057778888.json.gz
nina: quick grep of trace spans shows long kernel dispatch latencies on inference worker threads (span: inference.exec, duration 1.2s -> 3.1s) and blocked syscalls in rpc read.
thomas: hypothesis v1: kernel update altered scheduler behavior -> higher runqueue tail + futex contention on our inference process, causing p95 delta. hypothesis v2: contention from new telemetry daemon introduced at 11:29 causing IO spikes.
kevin: correlating iostat top: /dev/nvme0 spikes in io_wait at 11:30-11:35. but NVMe latency stays sub-ms. pointing back to CPU scheduling rather than disk.
aditya: to validate kernel hypothesis: can we boot one canary compute node on previous kernel (5.15.12) and run synthetic load? I'll spin one up in us-west1-canary-2.
michelle: do that. also collect `cat /proc/sched_debug` and `sysctl -a | grep sched` from affected box. add those to the artifact bucket.
aditya: synthetic load against 5.15.12 node shows stable p95 ~900ms. 5.15.13 node reproduces p95 ~3s under same load. capturing diffs and uploading.
kevin: short-term mitigation plan: rollback kernel on impacted pool to 5.15.12 (or drain nodes and replace with pre-patch AMI), continue routing to fallback, and increase batching window to reduce syscall churn.
michelle: agreed. rolling kernel rollback for pool inference-prod-1. ETA 15m. people to notify: support, sales (customer impact).
ops_bot: ROLLBACK_EVENT: rollback initiated by michelle at 11:58 UTC for pool inference-prod-1.
michelle: handoff: I'm handing to aditya for RCA documentation and timeline. I'll be monitoring rollback progress for 30m then transition to follow-up. @kevin @nina please add any perf counters/log diffs to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
aditya: on it — drafting RCA, will include timeline, perf traces, `sched_debug` diffs, and suggested mitigations (avoid auto-kernel-rollout during traffic windows, add preflight perf smoke tests).
michelle: closing handoff. next update expected in 45m with RCA draft.
